long_biography.plain_text:
Victor H. Mendelson built HEICO’s Electronic Technologies Group into a platform spanning aerospace, defence, space and specialised electronics. He founded the division in 1996 and has remained its president and chief executive. Fifteen years as HEICO’s general counsel also gave him direct responsibility for contracts, acquisitions and legal strategy.

HEICO’s acquisition model keeps purchased businesses operating under their own names, often with founders retaining stakes and day-to-day control. Mendelson helped apply that partnership approach across the electronics portfolio before becoming co-chief executive and co-chairman of the wider company. Beyond HEICO, he serves as vice-chair of Columbia University’s trustees and has held leadership roles with the Florida Grand Opera.
